The webpage outlines updates made by the Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) to the U.S. Standards for Grades of fresh fruits, vegetables, fruits and vegetables for processing, nuts, and specialty crops. Effective September 6, 2016, these revisions involve removing the “Unclassified” category from each standard to align them with recently amended standards and current terminology. This change aims to more accurately reflect contemporary marketing practices and provide the industry with greater flexibility. 

Contact information for Olivia Vernon from the Standardization Branch of the Specialty Crops Inspection Division is provided for further inquiries. Additionally, links to supporting documents such as the final rule and notice are available, offering detailed insights into these revisions.

The webpage outlines updates made by the Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) to the U.S. Standards for Grades of fresh fruits, vegetables, fruits and vegetables for processing, nuts, and specialty crops.
